court_scope: All cases assigned the SCDB abortion issue code; includes procedural and speech disputes, not only merits decisions about abortion access.
court_exclusions: Unknown direction, conflicting duplicate case rows, missing decision dates. Report exclusions explicitly.
survey_exclusions: Exclude anti-abortion movement thermometers and moral-acceptability questions from primary legal-policy analysis. Preserve them for separate sensitivity analyses.
aggregation: Existing respondent weighting and family selection within each source; equal available source weights. Analyze individual questions as a sensitivity check because circumstances and wording differ.
temporal_rule: Latest observed survey year strictly before decision year, at most five years old. No interpolation. This guarantees earlier fieldwork year, not historical public availability of the dataset.
prediction_gate: No real-time forecasting claim until historical data availability is verified. Chronological held-out evaluation required; compare against training-only majority and historical liberal-rate baselines.
review_gate: Review procedural versus substantive cases before treating SCDB ideological direction as abortion-access direction. Do not select cases based on observed alignment.

retrospective_evaluation.unit: case, grouped by decision calendar year
models: L2 logistic regression on prior survey sentiment, C=1, no tuning
retrospective_evaluation.status: Exploratory; evaluated with modern revised datasets. Not a historically deployable forecast or abortion-access outcome analysis.
